source_locator: Table 2 and Whole Exome Sequencing methods
method: Median of unflagged nonsynonymous counts divided by each nominal capture size, rounded to one decimal; no sample-specific kit or callable-base denominator inferred.
limitations: Approximate 0.2 mut/Mb from five classic HCL exomes: unflagged nonsynonymous counts 10,22,7,10,4 have median 10; divide by nominal 44.1-50 Mb capture sizes to obtain 0.20-0.23. Not a published TMB median or an independently validated callable-coding rate; sample-specific platform assignments and callable intersections are unavailable. Restrictive variant filtering matters: all candidate nonsynonymous counts 19,32,14,34,19 yield 0.38-0.43 by the same approximation. Ranges describe method sensitivity, not confidence intervals. Same rounded point as the withdrawn 0.2, with a different source and explicit approximate provenance.
